$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png'
DST='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_rotated_cw0p5_cross_bisectors_10px.png'
test -f "$SRC"
test ! -e "$DST"
test "$(sha256sum "$SRC" | awk '{print $1}')" = 'ae82854dcee417bec13dbfdb305b97239059c0dbd78387f6347c2f60267a5b58'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-rot05-cross-venv
/tmp/fishfry-rot05-cross-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry-rot05-cross-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageChops
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448.png')
dst=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_rotated_cw0p5_cross_bisectors_10px.png')
with Image.open(src) as im:
    original=im.convert('RGB')
assert original.size==(1448,1448),original.size
rotated=original.rotate(-0.5,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,expand=False,fillcolor='white')
result=rotated.copy()
# For 1448 x 1448, the center is (723.5,723.5) using pixel indices.
# A centered 10-pixel-wide bisector occupies rows and columns 719..728 inclusive.
draw=ImageDraw.Draw(result)
draw.rectangle((0,719,1447,728),fill=(0,0,0))
draw.rectangle((719,0,728,1447),fill=(0,0,0))
assert result.size==(1448,1448)
assert all(result.getpixel((x,y))==(0,0,0) for y in (0,719,723,724,728,1447) for x in range(719,729))
assert all(result.getpixel((x,y))==(0,0,0) for x in (0,719,723,724,728,1447) for y in range(719,729))
for left,right in ((0,719),(729,1448)):
    for top,bottom in ((0,719),(729,1448)):
        assert ImageChops.difference(result.crop((left,top,right,bottom)),rotated.crop((left,top,right,bottom))).getbbox() is None
result.save(dst,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
print('SOURCE',src,'DIMENSIONS',original.size,flush=True)
print('ROTATION','0.5 degrees clockwise','BICUBIC','expand=False','white fill',flush=True)
print('BISECTORS','black','10 pixels','horizontal y 719..728','vertical x 719..728',flush=True)
print('OUTPUT',dst,'DIMENSIONS',result.size,'BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$DST"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Rotate centered fish fry screen clockwise 0.5 degree and redraw bisectors'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main;then
    printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$DST" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
    printf 'LOCAL_BLOB ';git hash-object "$DST"
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLICATION_FAILED' >&2
exit 1
